canonical_data: A normal Obsidian vault of Markdown pages plus JSON source/claim ledgers and content-addressed raw source captures.
strengths: Content-addressed capture with source and claim ledgers tracking authority, confidence, and contradiction
One recoverable, lockable transaction per write, with journaled backups and atomic replacement
Deterministic local BM25 retrieval with optional, explicitly gated model-based reranking
Portable across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, and Windsurf via Agent Skills
weaknesses: Setup is deliberately multi-step (plan, review, approved-plan-sha256, apply), trading simplicity for safety
PDF/EPUB and OCR support is metadata-only without a configured external runner
Depends on a connected Agent Skills host to perform the actual synthesis and linking
Rapid star growth (14.8k stars, 1.5k forks) with no independent evidence yet of long-run maintenance
why_it_matters: Demonstrates that an agent-facing memory bridge can add real provenance and transaction safety on top of a vault humans still own as plain Markdown.
